title: Calibration Benchmark: Measuring Monitor Confidence Calibration Under Distribution Shift

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Poorly calibrated monitors lead to bad threshold decisions. Measuring calibration and testing simple fixes (temperature scaling) has direct practical value. Connects well-studied ML calibration theory to an unstudied domain.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Calibration curves and ECE are standard ML concepts with existing library support. Collecting suspicion scores requires only API calls. Temperature scaling is simple to implement. SHADE-Arena provides labeled data. Very accessible for CS students.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Well-defined deliverable: calibration curves and ECE measurements before and after distribution shift, with temperature scaling fix. Single coherent experiment. Feasible within 30 hours.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
